title: Identity/set args
description: Arguments for Identity/set (RFC 8621 §6.3). Clients may create identities for addresses they are permitted to send from, update existing identities, or destroy identities where mayDelete is true.

accountId.description: The account to update Identity objects in.

ifInState.description: Optimistic concurrency guard on Identity state.

create.description: Map of creation id to IdentityCreate objects. Clients may create an identity for an address they are permitted to send from.

update.description: Map of Identity id to IdentityUpdate patch objects.

destroy.description: Ids to destroy. Clients may destroy an identity whose mayDelete is true.
